title: My way of explaining my Mall World.
content: I’ve been to about 50 percent of locations, most all buildings. I had an odd occurrence at what felt like a jail with a large Olympic style pool? Only been there once but I was kidnapped and taken through the city and just wound up there. They can be bad or good dreams, most of the time they shutter back and forth. It feels like I’m in the original Total Recall movie crossed with the eXtiszenZ
